defects.description: Upload retries reuse an advanced body iterator, so successful replacement requests can omit previously consumed chunks.

trigger.input: timeout 15s node --input-type=module -e 'import {Session} from "./src/session.js"; import {MemoryEndpoint} from "./src/endpoint.js"; import {TransferError} from "./src/retry.js"; const endpoint=new MemoryEndpoint(async ({attempt,position})=>{if(attempt<3 && position===0) throw new TransferError("offline");}); const session=new Session(endpoint,{chunkSize:2,attempts:3}); session.enqueue("a","abcdef"); await session.flush(); console.log(JSON.stringify({body:endpoint.read("default/a").toString(),requests:endpoint.stats().requests}));'

defects.why_missed: S9(a,d): two failed replacement attempts followed by success consume a shared cursor; a success-only oracle accepts the receipt without checking the original bytes. Endpoint iteration and retry policy pass their independent contracts.

defects.description: Flush drops a pending entry before its receipt commits, losing the recovery obligation when receipt storage fails.

trigger.input: timeout 15s node --input-type=module -e 'import {Session} from "./src/session.js"; import {MemoryEndpoint} from "./src/endpoint.js"; import {Receipts} from "./src/receipts.js"; let writes=0; const receipts=new Receipts(async()=>{if(++writes===1) throw new Error("disk unavailable");}); const session=new Session(new MemoryEndpoint(),{},receipts); session.enqueue("a","report"); try {await session.flush();} catch {} await session.flush(); console.log(JSON.stringify({pending:session.status().pending,delivered:session.status().delivered,receipt:session.receipt("a")?.bytes??null}));'

defects.why_missed: S9(a,d): enqueue, failed receipt commit, and another flush leave no receipt despite an empty spool. Journal acknowledgement and atomic receipt save are individually correct, but their ordering is not.
